label: Curved French Style — 2 Buttonholes
description: The curved French cuff is a double cuff with its folded-back outer corner rounded off rather than squared, fastened with cufflinks through two buttonholes. The rounded edge gives a softer, slightly more relaxed take on the classic formal cuff without reducing its dressiness. It is favored by those who want the elegance of a French cuff with a gentler, less rigid line.
